definitions.explanation: A male deer, especially one with antlers. The counterpart of {雌鹿|めじか} (female deer, doe).

examples.japanese: {雄鹿|おじか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧にいた。
examples.english: There was a stag in the forest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{雄鹿|おじか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a stag with impressive antlers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雄鹿|おじか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縄張|なわば}り→縄張り：09337_nawabari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, male deer cry out to defend their territory.

notes:
Composed of {雄|お} (male) and ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ (deer). Also written as {牡鹿|おじか}. The ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧ becomes じか through rendaku (sequential voicing). Part of a common pair with ⟦{雌鹿|めじか}→雌鹿：27160_mejika⟧ (female deer, doe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄鹿|おじか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧ — a stag's antlers
